g.text: appliesSupersededHolding for it: the cited decision's status was already negative on the citing date, in a court whose decisions bind it. Dates on the 1st of a month in court-years with a month-

text.style: fill: #8a8a8a; font: 6.6px 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: precision pattern, and all 1 January dates, are dropped (812 decisions over all years). Bulk coverage thins after mid-2019. Sources: out/findings.tsv, data/decisions2.tsv.
